new_public_evidence.source: Ryu and Boyd, Adaptive Importance Sampling via Stochastic Convex Programming
new_public_evidence.result: Adaptive proposal updates can coexist with accumulation of an unbiased Monte Carlo estimate; supports exact reuse of pilot observations under original-proposal weighting in ordinary adaptive IS.
Current-experiment earlier stages can guide later allocations with inference theory; supports staged current-run information as an escape from history-only drift impossibility.

new_public_evidence.source: Owen and Zhou, Safe and Effective Importance Sampling
new_public_evidence.result: Defensive mixture sampling/control variates provide a variance-protection precedent for aggressive adaptive proposals.

new_public_evidence.source: Cornuet et al., Adaptive Multiple Importance Sampling
new_public_evidence.result: Past-sample recycling by retroactive mixture reweighting is a distinct method; the paper itself notes convergence properties were not established there, so it is not used as the exact reuse proof.

new_public_evidence.source: Pitt et al., Auxiliary Particle filtering within adaptive Metropolis-Hastings Sampling
new_public_evidence.result: Standard auxiliary particle-filter simulated likelihood / marginal-likelihood estimates can be unbiased, motivating a theorem-clean adaptation layer over independent mini-filter replicates.

derived_results.claim: If q_t is chosen from past information and X_t~q_t, then Z_t=h(X_t)p(X_t)/q_t(X_t) has conditional expectation mu. Therefore all pilot and production observations can be retained in a fixed equal-per-sample average with exact unbiasedness in ordinary adaptive importance sampling.

With pilot fraction gamma and later-stage per-sample variance ratio r, exact reuse has total ratio gamma+(1-gamma)r while discarding the pilot has ratio r/(1-gamma). Reuse beats discard iff r>(1-gamma)/(2-gamma). For gamma=0.25 the threshold is 0.428571...

The r129 negative result is specifically a discarded-pilot result. Under the same linear variance/second-moment proxy interpretation, gamma=0.25 and r=0.86553 map to a reused-pilot mean ratio 0.8991475; the p95 proxy maps from 1.01652 to 1.01239, so tail safety still is not established.

A 20,000-replicate 12-stratum synthetic rare-event adaptive-IS sanity check gave variance ratio 0.80713 for original-proposal-weighted pilot reuse versus base, while discarding the pilot gave 1.00364. Empirical means agreed with the common target within Monte Carlo error.

engineering_update.scope: Ordinary adaptive importance sampling proof plus a separate discrete rare-event toy; r129 Feynman-Kac numbers only reinterpreted algebraically. No within-filter independent-stratified PF reuse theorem established.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Pilot reuse is exact for ordinary predictable adaptive IS, not automatically for the existing multi-generation independent-stratified particle filter.
Pilot-dependent final blend weights can be biased because the pilot estimate and its weight are correlated; keep fixed per-sample aggregation unless a separate proof is supplied.
AMIS-style retroactive deterministic-mixture weights are not justified by the simple original-proposal martingale proof.
Particle-filter normalizing-constant unbiasedness supports a possible mini-filter/island architecture, but the exact objective and estimator must match before transfer.
No real-agent or AGI performance claim follows from the synthetic models.
